notConfigured: The chatbot has no language model to ask yet. An admin needs to set one up.
quotaExhausted: You have used up your chatbot tokens for this month.
failed: I could not get an answer just now. Please try again in a moment.
paused: The chatbot is paused because its API allowance ran out. Admins have been told; please try again later.

status.description: Show if the chatbot is on, its channels, default limit and model

enable.description: Turn the chatbot on in this server

disable.description: Turn the chatbot off in this server

channelAdd.description: Let the chatbot answer mentions in a channel

channelRemove.description: Stop the chatbot answering in a channel

limit.description: Set the default monthly token limit per member

quotaSet.description: Give a member their own monthly token limit, or remove it

quotaGrant.description: Add or take back bonus tokens for a member this month

quotaReset.description: Reset the tokens a member has used this month

usage.description: Show one member's tokens this month, or the top 10

memoryClear.description: Make the chatbot forget a member, a channel or everything

memory.description: Show what the chatbot remembers about you in this server

selfMemoryClear.description: Make the chatbot forget what it remembers about you here

selfUsage.description: Show your chatbot tokens left this month

history.description: Show your last 5 chatbot conversations in this server

historyClear.description: Delete your chatbot conversations in this server

clearOption.description: Remove the member's own limit and use the server default

tokensOption.description: Tokens to add; a negative number takes back

usageUserOption.description: Show this member only; leave empty for the top 10

clearUserOption.description: The member to clear (scope: one member)

clearChannelOption.description: The channel to clear (scope: one channel)

status.paused: Paused until {until}: the provider ran out of credit.
status.dashboardHint: Set the model on the dashboard.
